title: Real-time sign language detection: Empowering the disabled community
author: Kumar, Rani, et al.

steps.title: Load sign language dataset
steps.instruction: Load the sign language image dataset containing 702 images of letters into the working environment.

steps.title: Preprocess images
steps.instruction: Resize each image to the required input dimensions for VGG16 and convert the images to tensors (or appropriate array format) ready for model ingestion.

steps.title: Split dataset into train/validation
steps.instruction: Randomly select 600 images for the training set and 102 images for the validation set (14.5 % of the total dataset).

steps.title: Benchmark pre‑trained CNN models
steps.instruction: For each of the four pre‑trained models (VGG16, ResNet50, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2) train on the 600‑image training set using the same hyper‑parameters, then evaluate on the 102‑image validation set and record accuracy, precision, recall, and F1‑score.

substeps.instruction: Replace the final classification layer to match the number of sign classes.
Train the model on the training set (same optimizer, loss, epochs for all models).
Compute and store the four performance metrics on the validation set.

steps.title: Select VGG16 as base model
steps.instruction: Based on the benchmark results (VGG16: 97.5 % accuracy, 96.8 % precision, 97.2 % recall, 97.0 % F1‑score), choose VGG16 for the final system.

steps.title: Train baseline VGG16
steps.instruction: Train the VGG16 model (learning rate 0.001, batch size 32) on the training set for 30 epochs using the Adam optimizer and cross‑entropy loss, recording training and validation accuracy and loss each epoch.

steps.title: Integrate attention mechanism
steps.instruction: Add the self‑attention module to the VGG16 architecture, then train this modified model with the same hyper‑parameters (learning rate 0.001, batch size 32) for 30 epochs, again logging accuracy and loss for training and validation sets.

steps.title: Evaluate models on validation set
steps.instruction: For both the baseline and attention‑enhanced VGG16 models, compute accuracy, precision, recall, and F1‑score on the 102‑image validation set and generate a confusion matrix for each model.

steps.title: Test real‑time gesture recognition
steps.instruction: Deploy the trained VGG16‑with‑attention model to process live video frames of sign gestures, verify that each gesture is correctly recognized, and record qualitative performance observations.
